document_metadata.document_title: SFWMD Environmental Resource Permit Applicant's Handbook Volume II (Basis of Review)
document_metadata.version_or_edition: Effective July 4, 2010 (draft ERP Vol II mirror)

design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: SFWMD ERP AH Vol II: wet detention volume for the first inch of runoff from the developed project (or 2.5 in over the basin for projects with ≥50% impervious / special cases per rule); dry detention = 75% of wet; retention = 50% of wet. Quantity: off-site discharge typically based on 3-day / 25-year storm unless local criteria are more stringent; 100-year / 3-day considered for flood protection / finished floors.

evidence.excerpt: City of West Palm Beach is within SFWMD and follows ERP Applicant's Handbook Vol II
Wet detention volume shall be provided for the first inch of runoff
evidence.page_or_section: SFWMD Vol II water quality criteria

extraction_quality.review_notes: Municipality coverage via SFWMD ERP AH Vol II. Prefer city-specific drainage criteria if a durable public PDF appears.
